All 18 rules were searched across the full document and the plan is submitted. Summary of routing:

**Present and substantive (workers to read in full):**
- **LOL-CAP** — §§ 9.6–9.7 plus culpability-standard limits in Arts. V/VI (p0380, p0378, p0283, p0243).
- **INDEMN** — Servicer and Marketing Agent indemnities with Proceedings mechanic and survival (p0291–p0293, p0298).
- **T4C** — no convenience exit either way: § 8.3, § 7.1 No Resignation, § 7.2 Servicer Termination Events (p0363, p0314, p0317–p0318).
- **GOVLAW** — NY law, nonexclusive SDNY venue, jury waiver, plus scope-limited § 11.2 arbitration track (p0426–p0429, p0450–p0469).
- **ASSIGN** — § 10.2, § 5.3, § 7.6 (p0021 TOC pointer, p0249, p0348).
- **IP** — Receivable File custody, records and privacy-policy conditions (p0131–p0147, p0338, p0346).
- **AUDIT** — rights run in our favour (§ 3.6, § 6.7); flagged not to redline.
- **LD** — Make-Whole mechanics only; no penalty on us.
- **WARRANTY** — Servicer/Marketing Agent reps remade each Acquisition Date; non-waivable eligibility reps.
- **TRANSITION** — § 7.5 plus the p0346 software/process carve-out as the pressure point.

**Likely absent / not applicable:** NONCOMPETE, EXCLUSIVITY, MFN, NOSOLICIT, RENEWAL, LICENSE (only a negative covenant at p0346), INSURANCE, MINCOMMIT. Each was searched with multiple phrasings before being marked absent, and p0346 is cross-noted under LICENSE and TRANSITION so the same term is not flagged twice.
